verdict.rationale: Letta clearly supports adding memories from conversations (via /remember and automatic 'dreaming' consolidation) and persisting stateful agents across sessions/computers (letta-docs-6, letta-docs-27, letta-docs-24, letta-docs-17). However, semantic search over that memory is not native — it requires installing an optional 'MemFS Search mod' for semantic/hybrid search, with keyword search being the default (letta-docs-28, letta-docs-41), and community comments raise concerns about memory quality/context poisoning that temper confidence (letta-comm-4, letta-comm-5). Missing for 10: built-in (non-add-on) semantic search, independent hands-on verification that retrieved memories are accurate/relevant across sessions.
